title: template
description: Note Single-valued navigation properties (bind with <name>@odata.bind, expand with $expand): createdby, createdonbehalfby, modifiedby, modifiedonbehalfby, ownerid, owningbusinessunit, owningteam, owninguser.

body.description: Body text of the email template.

createdon.description: Date and time when the email template was created.

entityimage.description: Shows the default image for the record.

importsequencenumber.description: Unique identifier of the data import or data migration that created this record.

introducedversion.description: Version in which the form is introduced.

iscustomizable.description: Information that specifies whether this component can be customized.

ismanaged.description: Indicates whether the solution component is part of a managed solution.

ispersonal.description: Information about whether the template is personal or is available to all users.

isrecommended.description: Indicates if a template is recommended by Dynamics 365.

mimetype.description: MIME type of the email template.

modifiedon.description: Date and time when the email template was last modified.

openrate.description: Shows the open rate of this template.

presentationxml.description: XML data for the body of the email template.

replyrate.description: Shows the reply rate for this template.

solutionid.description: Unique identifier of the associated solution.

subject.description: Subject associated with the email template.

subjectpresentationxml.description: XML data for the subject of the email template.

subjectsafehtml.description: Safe html of email template subject.

usedcount.description: Shows the number of sent emails that use this template.

_createdby_value.description: Unique identifier of the user who created the email template.

_createdonbehalfby_value.description: Unique identifier of the delegate user who created the template.

_modifiedby_value.description: Unique identifier of the user who last modified the template.

_modifiedonbehalfby_value.description: Unique identifier of the delegate user who last modified the template.

_ownerid_value.description: Unique identifier of the user or team who owns the template for the email activity.

_owningbusinessunit_value.description: Unique identifier of the business unit that owns the template.

_owningteam_value.description: Unique identifier of the team who owns the template.

_owninguser_value.description: Unique identifier of the user who owns the template.
